url.description: The website URL exactly as you entered it in the input.

success.description: True when the page was rendered and a screenshot saved (billed); false for a free failure record.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was captured.

finalUrl.description: The URL that was actually captured, after following redirects.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code of the page (error pages such as 404 are still captured), or null when unknown.

title.description: The page title as shown in the browser tab, or null if it has none.

screenshotUrl.description: Direct download link to the screenshot image in the run's key-value store.

screenshotKey.description: Key of the screenshot record in the key-value store, for example screenshot-001-example-com.png.

width.description: Width of the captured image in pixels (viewport width times device scale factor).

height.description: Height of the captured image in pixels; the full page height when fullPage is true.

fullPage.description: True when the whole scrollable page was captured, false for a viewport or single-element capture.

device.description: Device preset used for the viewport, pixel density and user agent.

sizeBytes.description: File size of the screenshot image in bytes.

pdfUrl.description: Direct download link to the PDF render (only when 'Also render a PDF' is on).

pdfKey.description: Key of the PDF record in the key-value store (only when 'Also render a PDF' is on).

pdfSizeBytes.description: File size of the PDF in bytes (only when 'Also render a PDF' is on).

renderTimeMs.description: Milliseconds spent loading, preparing and capturing the page.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems during capture, e.g. 'waitForSelector timed out'. Present only when there was at least one.

errorType.description: Failure category when success is false.

error.description: Human-readable error message explaining why the page could not be captured.
